svg.text: Six static trim words; register loader is outside this block
Cold passive / noise laws remain unmeasured
Analog core V1 | one clock, shared physical support, one complete channel
Static trim nets are future register outputs. Register loading, backend event capture and networking are outside this assembly.
Complete routed core PEX | bounded initialization and tracking control
The native whole-core extraction includes all six modules and the complete assembly interconnect/coupling.
Native DC closure is removed before acquisition; physical Cf has no normal reset.
All upstream work is measured; AVDD and DVDD each have a finite feed and 100-pF VDD/VSS decoupling.
L_INIT is a numerical DC closure only; it is absent from every transient deck.
